description: This Java class 'ImportController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling CSV import functionality in a web application. It provides endpoints for displaying the import form and processing the CSV file import, utilizing a service class for CSV operations and managing imported client data.

classes.name: ImportController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling CSV import operations, including displaying the import form and processing CSV file uploads.

methods.name: importCsvView
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the CSV filename input form.

methods.name: importCsv
methods.description: Handles POST requests to import a CSV file, reads the file via the CsvImportExportService, and adds the result and client list to the model for rendering.
